tools.name: detect_ai_text
tools.description: Check whether text was written by AI. When there is a verdict, returns a 0-100 score and a label, with sentence scores for English and Portuguese (Spanish and French get a whole-text verdict only). Up to 10,000 words. Charged 1 credit per scored word only when a verdict is given.

tools.name: humanize_text
tools.description: Rewrite text so it reads as human-written. Up to 3,000 words. For a new task, waits up to 50 seconds and returns the rewritten text if done; if it is still running, pass the returned taskId as task_id to get_humanize_result. tools.name: get_humanize_result
tools.description: Get the status and, when finished, the rewritten text of a humanize task.
